data.body: Operator chose to move the openai arm to a newer model. Pushed Gerrit change 3336 patch set 1 (revision e0c6912f21c365f5a3197dcec7748a25eb2b2afd) as WIP under the 0.14.1 release hold: .github/llm-providers/openai.toml frontier and scalar model -> openai-responses:gpt-5.5, the README note, and docs/ci-provider-matrix.md section 'OpenAI arm model choice'. Source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/all (read 2026-11-09) lists gpt-5.5 as active. The pinned pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.9 profiles it the same as gpt-5.4. GPT-6 models need pydantic-ai-slim 2.x. make verify (Jira vars unset) exit 0 on the committed tree, 14:32 PST: 20847 passed, 202 integration passed. Plan review PASS at 13:44 PST. Not submitting until the coordinator sends RELEASED; the dispatch run follows the merge.
